title: Which Garmin smartwatch is right for me?
summary: Which Garmin watch should you get? Whether your focus is wellness, running or outdoor adventures, there's a Garmin smartwatch for everyone.
body_markdown:
[Fitness](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/)[General](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/general/)[Outdoor](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/outdoor/)


# Which Garmin smartwatch is right for me?


October 27, 2026


### **From mindful movers to runners to outdoor adventurers to golfers, there’s a Garmin smartwatch for everyone.**


If you’re reading this, maybe you’ve been asking yourself for a while:[Which Garmin watch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/which-watch/start/) should I get?


The answer depends on how you’re planning on using it. But luckily for you, whether you’re looking for a smartwatch with essential wellness tracking features, advanced running metrics, rich mapping details for your outdoor adventures, premium golf features or even a[smartwatch with SOS](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/inreach-technology-for-watches/) messaging1, you’ll find what you need with Garmin.


That said, we know we have a lot of options. If you can’t decide[which Garmin watch is best for you](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/wearables-smartwatches/) , look no further. We’re going to explain each of our watch options.


*The Garmin Venu® 4 GPS smartwatch is perfect for tracking your wellness and fitness essentials.*


## Perfect for essential wellness tracking


[Lily® 2 Active](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1196650/pn/010-02891-00/) : This small and stylish smartwatch has a metal case with a hidden display (just tap it to reveal the bright display) and essential wellness features — including heart rate, Body Battery™ energy monitoring,[sleep tracking](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/activity-fitness-trackers/) and women’s health features — to give you a more complete picture of your health2.


- Battery life: Up to 9 days in smartwatch mode
- Case size: 38 mm
- Display type: Liquid crystal hidden behind a patterned lens that blends in with the watch colors


## Perfect for wellness tracking and hitting the gym


[vívoactive® 6](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1555457) : This smartwatch offers a bright AMOLED display and a variety of health and fitness features — so you can monitor your health in and out of the gym. vívoactive 6 includes more than 80 preloaded sports apps so you can stay on top of your fitness. You can also use[Garmin Coach running](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/garmin-training-plans-for-runners/) and strength training plans — some of which adapt based on performance, recovery and health metrics.


- Battery life: Up to 11 days in smartwatch mode
- Case size: 42 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


## Perfect for tracking your wellness, workouts and fitness metrics


[Venu® 4](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1613801/pn/010-03013-00/) : With detailed health and fitness insights, the ECG app3, a bright AMOLED display, a built-in speaker and microphone (to make and take calls from the watch when paired with a smartphone and connected to the phone’s voice assistant), Garmin Coach and dozens of sports apps, Venu 4 is ready to help you serve looks — or serve on the pickleball court. Plus, light your way with the built-in LED flashlight. The[advanced health](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/health/top-10-features-to-monitor-your-health/) and fitness features — including skin temperature tracking2 for more accurate period predictions and past ovulation estimates4 — can help you better understand your body and make healthier decisions. It also offers a sophisticated metal design and two size options.


- Battery life: Up to 12 days on the 45 mm size in smartwatch mode
- Case size: 41 mm or 45 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


## Perfect for wellness-minded runners, multisport athletes and gym rats


[Venu X1](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1510465/) : This premium GPS smartwatch features an easy-to-read 2” AMOLED display with a scratch-resistant sapphire lens — and our thinnest watch case. Venu X1 offers detailed health and fitness insights as well as advanced running features and mapping. It includes a built-in LED flashlight as well as a built-in speaker and microphone. Whether you’re training with Garmin Coach, recovering on off days or navigating a new running route, you can trust Venu X1.


- Battery life: Up to 8 days in smartwatch mode
- Case size: 41 x 46 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


*With Forerunner® 970 and HRM 600, you’ll find your new fast.*


## Perfect for new runners


[Forerunner 70](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1941179/) **/**[Forerunner 170 Music:](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/2014513/pn/010-03920-12/) When you’re[getting started as a runner](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/how-to-start-running-6-tips-for-new-runners/) , you need a watch with essential training features to cross the finish line. That’s where the Forerunner 70 and Forerunner 170 Music come into play. Along with built-in GPS for time, distance and pace, long battery life, sleep monitoring and wrist-based heart rate2, these Forerunners curate daily suggested workouts that match performance and recovery after every run. Plus, take advantage of beginner-friendly Garmin Coach training plans with run-walk workouts in the[Garmin Connect™ app](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/general/unlocking-the-potential-of-garmin-connect/) . If you want to quickly set up a running workout based on your available training time and desired intensity level, the quick workout feature will create a workout for you.


When you have the Forerunner 170 music, download your favorite songs, podcasts and more to listen with your wireless headphones from your watch (subscription may be required). If you need to refuel, stop for a mid-run snack, water or gel, and use Garmin Pay™ contactless payments to pay from your wrist5.


It’s time to sign up for that 5K when you have a Foreunner 70 or 170 Music on your wrist.


- Battery life: Forerunner 70 up to 13 days and Forerunner 170 Music up to 10 days in smartwatch mode
- Case size: 43 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


## Perfect for advanced runners


[Forerunner 570](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1464001/) : Let’s up your running game. You need[training status](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/garmin-training-status-and-how-to-use-it/) , training readiness, multi-band GPS support and adaptive training plans from[Garmin Run Coach](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/garmin-training-plans-for-runners/) . Forerunner 570 includes a built-in speaker and microphone, an aluminum bezel and advanced running features.


- Battery life: Up to 11 days on the 47 mm size
- Case size: 42 mm or 47 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


## Perfect for runners and multisport athletes who want a premium watch


[Forerunner 970](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1462801/) : With a sapphire crystal lens, titanium bezel and longer battery life for intense training,[Forerunner 970](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/the-difference-between-garmin-forerunner-965-and-970/) is ready for your next long run or bike ride. Train for your next race — whether that’s a marathon, half-marathon or even triathlon — or improve your fitness with adaptive training plans from Garmin Coach. It also adds a wealth of advanced running features, such as running tolerance, which can recommend weekly maximum mileage. When you also train with your[heart rate monitor](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/scales-monitors/?series=38360) such as[HRM 600](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1473393/) , the running economy feature will show your overall energy efficiency while running. This feature also includes data such as step speed loss, which shows how much you slow down when your foot hits the ground. There is a built-in LED flashlight, speaker and microphone, and more upgrades to help you take your sport to the next level. (You can compare all of our[running smartwatches here](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/running/which-garmin-running-smartwatch-is-right-for-me/) ).


- Battery life: Up to 15 days in smartwatch mode
- Case size: 47 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


*The fēnix® 9 Pro premium multisport GPS smartwatch is perfect for adventurers who want to stay connected.*


## Perfect for multisport athletes who love outdoor adventures


[fēnix 9](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/2021175/) : This is our premium GPS multisport smartwatch. The purpose-built design includes a dive-rated build with leakproof metal buttons, a metal sensor guard, a titanium bezel, a built-in LED flashlight, and speaker and microphone. You’ll get all the health and wellness monitoring features you already love as well as premium training, planning and analysis features for athletes and extreme adventurers. Plus, multiday activities can be tracked as a single experience using[Garmin Epic](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/maps-for-smartwatches/garmin-epic/) . The[fēnix 9](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/outdoor/the-difference-between-fenix-8-and-9/) Series also offers an extra bright AMOLED display.


- Battery life: Up to 29 days in smartwatch mode on the 51 mm size
- Case size: 43 mm, 47 mm and 51 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


## Perfect for athletes and explorers who want to stay connected on the go


[fēnix 9 Pro](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1962767/pn/010-04335-85/) : This smartwatch with a sleek, lightweight and durable design features a titanium bezel and case. Pro users can also choose between the extremely bright AMOLED display or solar charging MIP display. When in areas with limited to no cell service,[fenix 9 Pro users with SOS](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/inreach-technology-for-watches/) receive inReach® connectivity for satellite and cellular coverage1 in all 3 case sizes. That way, you can communicate with those back home or trigger an SOS message to[Garmin Response](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/outdoor/get-to-know-garmin-response/) ℠, our 24/7-staffed international emergency coordination center, to get connected with help if you need it. Elite athletes and outdoor enthusiasts will also have access to advanced fitness features, training stats and more from the wrist and in Garmin Connect. Learn more about[fēnix 9 series smartwatches](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/outdoor/the-difference-between-fenix-8-and-9/) .


- Battery life: Up to 31 days in smartwatch mode on the AMOLED 51 mm size or up to 57 days with solar charging on the 51 mm size
- Case size: 43 mm, 47 mm and 51 mm
- Display type: AMOLED or solar charging with a sunlight-readability, transflective memory-in-pixel (MIP) display


## Perfect for runners who want the ultimate endurance watch


**[Enduro™ 4](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/2032078/)** : Built for ultramarathoners, endurance athletes and trail runners, Enduro 4 is the high-performing GPS smartwatch you’ve been looking for. Enduro 4 includes an LED flashlight and routable maps with up to 30% faster panning than the previous version so you can quickly load trail data. Track over 100 activities and start an Epic to combine multiple days of activity into a single experience. As you conquer various terrains, grade-adjusted features help you manage your effort and provide pace overviews. To build upon your training efforts, use stamina metrics and advanced rowing and rucking features.


- Battery life: Up to 320 hours in activity mode7 with solar charging or up to 90 days in smartwatch mode6
- Case size: 51 mm
- Display type: Sunlight-readability, transflective memory-in-pixel (MIP) display


## Perfect for outdoor adventurers who want a rugged watch


[Instinct® 3](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1622337/) : With a metal-reinforced bezel, fiber-reinforced polymer case and a scratch-resistant display for extreme durability, Instinct 3 is purpose-built for adventurers who love enjoying the great outdoors. It also features a built-in LED flashlight, multiple sizes and a solar option that can bring you up to unlimited battery life6. Plus, you can get this watch packed with[tactical features](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1718241/pn/010-03020-50/) , including night vision capability, rucking activity, stealth mode (which collects distances and biometrics without recording location data), projected waypoints and many more.


- Battery life: Up to 24 days in smartwatch mode on the 50 mm size or up to unlimited battery life with solar charging6
- Case size: 45 mm and 50 mm
- Display type: AMOLED or a solar charging, monochrome, sunlight- readability and transflective MIP display


## Perfect for those who need a tactical watch built for the mission


[tactix® 8](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1828641/pn/010-03406-00/) : This next-gen[tactical smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/outdoor/the-best-tactical-garmin-watches/) offers leakproof buttons, a sensor guard, a titanium bezel and a scratch-resistant sapphire lens for extreme durability. tactix 8 features a built-in LED flashlight with a white (disabled in night vision mode) or green beam (which becomes dimmable in night vision mode). It also includes tactical features such as rucking, jumpmaster activity, waypoint project, dual-position GPS format, stealth mode, kill switch, Applied Ballistics® solver, compatibility with night vision goggles, a dedicated tactical activity and more.


- Battery life: Up to 29 days in smartwatch mode on the 51 mm size or up to 48 days with solar charging6
- Case size: 47 mm or 51 mm
- Display type: AMOLED or solar charging with a sunlight-readable, transflective MIP display


**Hit the course with Approach® S72, the ultimate Garmin golf smartwatch* .*


## Perfect for golfers looking for essentials


[Approach S44](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1604358/) : You’ll get all the golfing essentials — and then some — with the Approach S44 GPS golf smartwatch, including the[green view feature](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/golf-science/distance-measurement/green-pin/) to see each green’s shape from anywhere on the course and AutoShot game tracking to automatically track where your shots land9. Plus, with a[Garmin Golf™ membership](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/850633/pn/010-13322-SU) , you can get premium features such as Premium CourseView maps, touch targeting and green contour data.


- Battery life: Up to 15 hours in GPS mode
- Case size: 43 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


## Perfect for on and off the golf course


[Approach S50](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1604377/) : This advanced GPS smartwatch helps you easily see key yardages to the green, hazards and layups on more than 43,000 courses. Thanks to the PlaysLike Distance feature, you can see how far each shot is playing with yardage adjusted for elevation changes. (Don’t forget to add on a Garmin Golf membership for access to even more features). You’ll also get essential health and wellness features as well as preloaded activities to help you improve your strength and mobility.


- Battery life: Up to 10 days in smartwatch mode
- Case size: 43 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


## Perfect for golfers who want premium features


[Approach S72](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1937140/) : This premium GPS golf smartwatch comes in two sizes and ComfortFit fabric band that won’t interfere with your swing. It also includes a built-in LED flashlight and speaker and microphone. Golfers will have everything they need to improve on and off the course thanks to advanced swing metrics, the virtual caddie feature (which includes a dispersion chart that displays hazards in play, depending on club choice), enhanced PlaysLike Distance (which accounts for changes in elevation and environmental conditions), club suggestions based on performance and wind9, and preloaded fitness apps for strength, running and more. Beyond the fairways, use this golf smartwatch to track over 100 other activities and view various health and wellness metrics. (Need to dive deeper on our golf watches? Learn more about your[golf smartwatch options](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/golf-gps-devices-smartwatches/?FILTER_FEATURE_GOLFWATCH=true#shopgolfdevices) ).


- Battery life: Up to 20 hours on the course and up to 16 days with GPS turned off on the 47 mm size
- Case size: 43 mm or 47 mm
- Display type: AMOLED


Now that you’ve got a better idea of our options, it’s time to choose which Garmin watch is best for your needs. You can[browse our full selection of smartwatches](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/wearables-smartwatches/) .
